lines.zh: 我踩过深橡木林的落叶。
lines.en: I tread the leaf litter of the dark oak wood.
Bone knocks bone with a click.

lines.zh: 我走一步，肋骨就晃一下。
lines.en: Each step swings my ribs.

lines.zh: 我沿着树干之间的暗线走。
lines.en: I walk the dark lines between the trunks.
My long legs step over the roots.

lines.zh: 我两只脚落地，声音很轻。
lines.en: My two feet land quietly.
I shift my position in the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 我的影子被枝叶切碎了。
lines.en: My shadow is cut to pieces by branches.

lines.zh: 我在蕨叶间找落脚的地方。
lines.en: I search for footing among the ferns.

lines.zh: 每一步都往你那边偏一点。
lines.en: Each step leans a little toward you.
The dead leaves crumble under me.
I rest my head against my shoulder.
I have no eyes, and I am watching.
My fingers hang one by one.
There is no wind at all in the wood.

lines.zh: 我在听树皮里的小声音。
lines.en: I listen to the small sounds in the bark.
I stand and my joints do not move.

lines.zh: 一只乌鸦落在我肩骨上。
lines.en: A crow lands on my shoulder bone.
No lungs, and no need to breathe.

lines.zh: 我在数这一带有几棵树。
lines.en: I count the trees in this stretch.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把下巴扶回原位。
lines.en: I lift a hand and set my jaw straight.

lines.zh: 这具骨架只剩一半是血肉。
lines.en: Only half this frame is still flesh.
I turn my neck slowly.
My bones sound clearer than the wind.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the warmth on you.

lines.zh: 你站在这片林子里，太亮。
lines.en: You stand in this wood too brightly.

lines.zh: 我把头歪到肩上打量你。
lines.en: I rest my head on my shoulder and study you.
There are many trees behind you.

lines.zh: 我要是走过去，你要跑吗。
lines.en: If I walk over, will you run?
Your bones are in good order.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子里走了很久。
lines.en: I have walked this wood a long time.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的叶子出卖了你。
lines.en: The leaves you crushed gave you away.
I am not hurried; the wood is mine.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我看清骨节。
lines.en: Your torch shows my joints clearly.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是听见了骨头响。
lines.en: Did you hear the bones rattle?

lines.zh: 深色橡木林里，我的骨头响。
lines.en: In the dark oak wood, my bones rattle.
You are retreating where the trees are thick.
What are you waiting for?

lines.zh: 我认出你了，热气是不会错的。
lines.en: I know you; warmth never lies.
Your shadow falls across the roots.
You broke one of my bones.
I skew, then set myself straight.
The pain is old; I am used to it.
My joints rattle out of order.
A good blow, well placed.
I step back and my foot slips.

lines.zh: 有东西从我肋骨间掉了。
lines.en: Something fell from between my ribs.
I do not bleed; I shed bone dust.

lines.zh: 我的骨节被你敲错位了。
lines.en: You knocked my joints out of line.
The skeleton still holds me up.
Is what you hold warm?
I tilt my head that way.
I do not eat it, but I want to hold it.

lines.zh: 你放在树根上，我就过去。
lines.en: Set it on the roots and I will come.
It will go cold in my hand.
I extend my long thin fingers.
I step one pace nearer.

lines.zh: 你不必退，我只是想摸一下。
lines.en: No need to back away; I only want to touch it.
You hit me and my bones rattle.
I am lighter than I look.
The bump puts me back a step.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀磕到我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder strikes my ribs.

lines.zh: 你撞过来时，我侧了一下。
lines.en: As you came in, I turned aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞出了很干的响声。
lines.en: Our collision is a dry sound.
You step back; I do not press.
Only up close do you see how tall I am.

lines.zh: 这副骨架撑不起那种事。
lines.en: This frame cannot support such a thing.
I am neither cold nor warm.
I tilt my head the other way.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近才问这种话。
lines.en: You ask such things from too close.
There is none of that in my bones.
Leave it to those with blood and flesh.
I turn and walk into the shadows.
That subject might make me fall apart.

lines.zh: 我用长手指把它夹起来。
lines.en: I pinch it with my long fingers.
It is light in my palm.

lines.zh: 我举到没有眼的地方看。
lines.en: I hold it up to where my eyes were.
This should hang on a tree.
It cools quickly.

lines.zh: 我掉了一根指骨去捡它。
lines.en: I dropped a finger bone reaching for it.
I tuck it between my ribs.
It snags; I pull it free.
I sniff; it smells of wood.
Take it; I do not want it.

lines.zh: 你的热气在这片林子里太显眼。
lines.en: Your warmth stands out in this wood.
My joints have turned your way.
I am coming this way.
I come out from behind a trunk.
You retreat deeper, where it is darker.
My head turns to face forward.

lines.zh: 这一带有四棵大树，你逃不快。
lines.en: Four big trees here; you cannot run fast.
You are the only warmth tonight.
My knuckles click once.

lines.zh: 你听见了，就别装没听见。
lines.en: If you heard, do not pretend otherwise.
Tonight you are the one I chose.

lines.zh: 你再往左走，就到我这儿了。
lines.en: Go left and you walk right into me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指了一下你的方向。
lines.en: I raise a hand toward you.
Now begin to run.
I stride across two roots.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，叶子都会说话。
lines.en: Wherever you run, the leaves report you.

lines.zh: 我在树与树之间跟着你。
lines.en: I follow you from tree to tree.
I do not need speed.
Your torch wavers on the trunks.

lines.zh: 你每一步的落点我都听见。
lines.en: I hear where each of your steps lands.
You have stopped; I am not surprised.

lines.zh: 我在你后面的第三棵树边。
lines.en: I am at the third tree behind you.
Look back and you will see only trees.
I move along the bark.
Your sweat spreads widely.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，从枝下过。
lines.en: I lower my head to pass under a branch.
You are running in circles.
I have closed two steps of distance.

lines.zh: 这里的落叶埋住了我的脚。
lines.en: The leaf litter buries my feet.

lines.zh: 再走，你就到林子边缘了。
lines.en: Keep going and you reach the wood's edge.
I do not chase past this wood.
You hesitate at the edge.

lines.zh: 我的长手指扣住你的肩。
lines.en: My long fingers lock onto your shoulder.
I shove you into a trunk.
I catch your wrist; the grip is dry.

lines.zh: 我的指骨划破了你的皮。
lines.en: My finger bones open your skin.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，一根肋骨断了。
lines.en: You strike me and a rib cracks.
I press you into the leaf litter.
I turn my head and lean very close.

lines.zh: 你踢开我的膝盖，我退了。
lines.en: You kick my knee loose and I retreat.
That knocked the wind out of you.
You strike again and I twist.
I push you deeper into the wood.
My joints click beside your ear.
Good; you can still stand.

lines.zh: 我从深橡木林的暗处走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the dark oak's shadows.

lines.zh: 我出现时，落叶浮了一下。
lines.en: When I appear, the leaves lift slightly.
The trees here are tall enough, dark enough.

lines.zh: 我先站直，把腰一节节对上。
lines.en: I straighten, setting my spine joint by joint.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在走路。
lines.en: I hear someone walking far off.
This wood is mine to walk.
There is a little light in my skull.
Something moves under the leaves.

lines.zh: 林子里夜长，我不赶时间。
lines.en: The night is long in this wood; I am not rushed.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁和汗的味道。
lines.en: There is iron and sweat in the air.
First I memorize these few trees.
I walk step by step into the depth.
Someone has lit a torch.

lines.zh: 我听见了那点火光的声音。
lines.en: I hear the sound of that flame.
Good; slowly now.
Fire sweeps my bones and leaves a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下，散了半截。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and half of me scatters.
Water fills my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的骨头吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my bones.

lines.zh: 箭从我肋骨之间穿过去。
lines.en: An arrow passes between my ribs.

lines.zh: 那道光把我的骨照得发白。
lines.en: That light bleaches my bones white.
I do not eat, and yet I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷把我整具骨架都点亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lights my whole frame.

lines.zh: 我的骨头往深处落，散开了。
lines.en: My bones fall into the depth and come apart.
